source.text: The user asks which came first: the Seven Days Battles or the Battle of Manila. This requires determining the historical timeline of these events within the United States. The Seven Days Battles were a series of American Civil War battles in Virginia in 1862. The Battle of Manila could refer to several events — the 1898 battle during the Spanish-American War, or possibly WWII events in 1945. The 1898 Battle of Manila was part of the Spanish-American War. Since the Civil War (1861-1865) predates the Spanish-American War (1898), the Seven Days Battles (1862) should be earlier than the Battle of Manila (1898). To confirm these dates and ensure there isn't a different Battle of Manila that might be earlier, I should search for precise information.
